g.text: AoiRank4Convo3 begins.
You've never told me anything about your family.
You know, we've covered a lot of topics, but your upbringing is still a mystery to me.
what would u like to know?
Tell me about your parents.
Any siblings?
they were great. just kinda distant
nope. just lil ol' me. how about u?
we didn't always see eye-to-eye
Check boolean DrifterSiblingYes
About music? :P
I'm sure that's true for most kids.
About how you should spend your life?
I had a sibling.
true
Check boolean DrifterSiblingNo
false
LOL actually yes, but that wasn't a big deal
ur probably right. funny how we can all be so similar yet so different.
ya. more or less.
Update boolean DrifterSiblingYes
false
Oh. Not technically? But all us kids on the Zariman were basically raised together.
true
false
I had a very high risk tolerance for my own life. my parents? not so much
past tense... do u mind if I ask what happened?
Update boolean DrifterSiblingNo
they were so upset when I told them I'd enlisted to be a soldier. didn't make much difference to them that it was for peace keeping
Same thing that happened to my parents. The Man in the Wall.
I'd rather not get into it.
was it nice? growing up with all those other kids?
They were concerned for their daughter's safety.
They underestimated you.
They should have been proud of you.
u've been through so much
ok. I understand.
Sometimes. They're not all fond memories. Kids can be mean, you know?
The best. We really understood each other. I took that for granted.
To be honest, I wished I was an only child most of the time.
+10 Chemistry
I wouldn't say that. they just wanted their only daughter to be safe...
I think they were, but they were concerned too. they didn't want anything to hurt their only daughter.
I'm sorry
Did you like being an only child?
How about your parents? What were they like?
I do know. nothing can be perfect, I guess
it makes me so happy to hear that ^_^
oh that's too bad
definitely. wish I'd been more grateful for that at the time... and more understanding.
I’m incredibly lucky to have parents who cared as deeply as they did. it’s just a shame our family never found a way to show it openly.
Sorry, I didn't mean to make this about me.
It's okay. I'll get my revenge one day.
Everyone's been through a lot. Not just me.
I always imagined it would be better to grow up in a house with other kids
if I get the chance to see them again, I’ll make things right. I'll shower them in love haha
no please it's okay. I'm just happy that ur willing to let me know u on a deeper level
u will. I really believe that.
all the more reason to be there for each other
there was school I guess but that's not the same
Good luck with that.
You'll see them again one day. I'm sure of it.
Let's hope you get that chance.
Let's get back to you. Your parents still around?
That's kind of you. So, where were we? You were going to tell me about your parents?
if mom and dad argue, the kids at school aren't *really* in it with u
thx... I think?
+10 Chemistry
I'll do everything in my power to make it so
I think so. it's been ages since I heard any kind of update but... ya. they'd be back home.
aah the Morohoshi household was a happy one indeed
Saves you from fighting with the other kids though. Lol.
Did your parents fight a lot?
That's true. There was always someone there.
it's nice to reminisce anyway
u know, hearing someone else say that makes it feel more true <3
thx for asking about them
You happy about that?
Did you get along with them?
I can't tell if you're serious.
That explains why you're so nice.
true. I appreciate that silver lining lol
oh no I didn't mean that
that's truly special
most of the hex get so bummed out remembering home. we don't talk about family much.
it's nice to be asked about mom and dad :)
lol of course I am
we got along well enough
I am - sort of. "happy" doesn't really describe mom and dad
oh that's so sweet of u. heh... is it bad that I was exaggerating a little?
Did you get along with your parents?
What were your parents like?
Except Arthur and Eleanor, of course.
That's too bad. We should keep those memories alive.
I can understand why they'd feel that way.
my parents were...
of course <3
agreed :) but I get where they're coming from
ya. me too.
well, I'd better get going for now
Alright. Take care of yourself.
For now?
Thanks for letting me get to know you better.
u too <3
ya :) we're definitely gonna talk again soon, silly
it's easy when you make me feel so safe <3
Chat ends.
